summary.en: Say hello, introduce yourself and ask simple questions about other people.
summary.uz: Salomlashing, oʻzingizni tanishtiring va boshqalar haqida oddiy savollar bering.
summary.ru: Поздоровайтесь, представьтесь и задайте простые вопросы о других людях.

items.example: Hello, I'm Dilnoza. Nice to meet you.

note.en: Say this the first time you meet someone.
note.uz: Buni kimdir bilan birinchi marta uchrashganda ayting.
note.ru: Скажите это при первой встрече с человеком.

items.example: Where are you from? I'm from Samarkand.
What do you do? I'm a student at the university.

note.en: This question asks about someone's job or studies.
note.uz: Bu savol kimningdir ishi yoki oʻqishi haqida soʻraydi.
note.ru: Этот вопрос о работе или учёбе человека.

items.example: This is my friend, Aziz. He works at a bank.

items.phrase: How do you spell your name?
items.example: How do you spell your name? D-I-L-N-O-Z-A.
It was nice talking to you. See you soon!

items.title: The verb 'be' in the present

explanation.en: Use am with I, is with he, she and it, and are with you, we and they. In questions, put the verb first: Are you from Tashkent?
explanation.uz: I bilan am, he, she va it bilan is, you, we va they bilan are ishlatiladi. Savolda feʼl birinchi keladi: Are you from Tashkent?
explanation.ru: Используйте am с I, is с he, she, it и are с you, we, they. В вопросе глагол стоит первым: Are you from Tashkent?

examples: Are you a student? Yes, I am.

lines.text: Hello! I'm Dilnoza. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. I'm Tom.

lines.speaker: Dilnoza
lines.text: Where are you from, Tom?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm from Manchester, in England. And you?

items.prompt: You meet a new colleague for the first time. What do you say?

explanation.en: 'Nice to meet you' is the usual phrase at a first meeting. 'See you soon' is for saying goodbye.
explanation.uz: 'Nice to meet you' birinchi uchrashuvdagi odatiy ibora. 'See you soon' xayrlashishda aytiladi.
explanation.ru: 'Nice to meet you' — обычная фраза при первой встрече. 'See you soon' говорят при прощании.

items.sentence: My sister ___ a nurse in Tashkent.

explanation.en: 'My sister' is she, so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.uz: 'My sister' — bu she, shuning uchun feʼl 'is' boʻladi.
explanation.ru: 'My sister' — это she, поэтому глагол 'is'.

items.prompt: Match each question with its answer.

explanation.en: Each answer gives the information the question asks for: a place, a job, or letters.
explanation.uz: Har bir javob savol soʻragan maʼlumotni beradi: joy, kasb yoki harflar.
explanation.ru: Каждый ответ даёт то, о чём спрашивает вопрос: место, профессию или буквы.

items.prompt: Put the words in the right order to make a question.

explanation.en: In questions with 'be', the verb comes first: Are you from Tashkent?
explanation.uz: 'Be' bilan savollarda feʼl birinchi keladi: Are you from Tashkent?
explanation.ru: В вопросах с 'be' глагол стоит первым: Are you from Tashkent?

items.title: A new neighbour
items.text: My name is Kamola and I live in Tashkent. Last week a new family moved into the flat next to mine. The mother, Nargiza, is a doctor at the city hospital. Her husband, Bekzod, works from home as a designer. They have two children. The older one, Jasur, is ten and loves football. The younger one, Malika, is six and likes drawing. On Saturday we had tea together and talked about our jobs and the city. Now we are friends, and Jasur plays football with my brother every evening.

questions.prompt: What is Nargiza's job?

explanation.en: The text says Nargiza is a doctor at the city hospital.
explanation.uz: Matnda Nargiza shahar kasalxonasida shifokor deb aytilgan.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано, что Наргиза — врач в городской больнице.

questions.prompt: Where does Bekzod work?

explanation.en: Bekzod works from home as a designer.
explanation.uz: Bekzod uyda dizayner boʻlib ishlaydi.
explanation.ru: Бекзод работает дома дизайнером.

questions.prompt: When did Kamola and the family have tea?

explanation.en: The last sentence says they had tea together on Saturday.
explanation.uz: Oxirgi gapda ular shanba kuni birga choy ichgani aytilgan.
explanation.ru: В последнем предложении сказано, что они пили чай вместе в субботу.

items.title: A new colleague
items.transcript:
Aziz: Good morning. Are you the new designer?
Dilnoza: Yes, I am. My name is Dilnoza. Nice to meet you.
Aziz: Nice to meet you too, Dilnoza. I'm Aziz. I work in the sales team.
Dilnoza: Where is the sales team?
Aziz: On the second floor, next to the kitchen. Where are you from?
Dilnoza: I'm from Samarkand, but I live in Tashkent now.
Aziz: Welcome to the team. Let's have lunch together at one o'clock.

questions.prompt: What is Dilnoza's job?

explanation.en: Aziz asks if she is the new designer, and she says yes.
explanation.uz: Aziz undan yangi dizayner ekanini soʻraydi va u «ha» deydi.
explanation.ru: Азиз спрашивает, новый ли она дизайнер, и она отвечает «да».

questions.prompt: Where is the sales team?

explanation.en: Aziz says the sales team is on the second floor, next to the kitchen.
explanation.uz: Aziz savdo boʻlimi ikkinchi qavatda, oshxona yonida ekanini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Азиз говорит, что отдел продаж на втором этаже, рядом с кухней.

questions.prompt: Where is Dilnoza from?

explanation.en: She is from Samarkand, but she lives in Tashkent now.
explanation.uz: U Samarqanddan, lekin hozir Toshkentda yashaydi.
explanation.ru: Она из Самарканда, но сейчас живёт в Ташкенте.

prompt.en: Introduce yourself to a new neighbour: your name, where you are from, and what you do.
prompt.uz: Yangi qoʻshningizga oʻzingizni tanishtiring: ismingiz, qayerdanligingiz va nima ish qilishingiz.
prompt.ru: Представьтесь новому соседу: имя, откуда вы и чем занимаетесь.

selfCheck.en: I said where I am from.

summary.en: Talk about your day, your week and how often you do things.
summary.uz: Kuningiz, haftangiz va biror ishni qanchalik tez-tez qilishingiz haqida gapiring.
summary.ru: Расскажите о своём дне, неделе и о том, как часто вы что-то делаете.

instructions.en: Read the phrases and the example dialogue. Say each phrase aloud.
instructions.uz: Iboralar va namunaviy suhbatni oʻqing. Har bir iborani ovoz chiqarib ayting.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте фразы и пример диалога. Произнесите каждую фразу вслух.

items.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock.
I have breakfast at home with my family.
I go to work by bus. It takes twenty minutes.

note.en: Use 'by' with transport: by bus, by car, by metro. But say 'on foot'.
note.uz: Transport bilan 'by' ishlatiladi: by bus, by car, by metro. Lekin 'on foot' deyiladi.
note.ru: С транспортом используйте 'by': by bus, by car, by metro. Но говорят 'on foot'.

items.phrase: What time do you finish work?
items.example: What time do you finish work? At six.
In the evening I cook dinner and watch the news.
At the weekend I visit my grandparents.

note.en: British English says 'at the weekend'; American English says 'on the weekend'.
note.uz: Britaniya ingliz tilida 'at the weekend', Amerika ingliz tilida 'on the weekend' deyiladi.
note.ru: В британском английском говорят 'at the weekend', в американском — 'on the weekend'.

items.title: Present simple and how often

explanation.en: Use the present simple for things you do regularly. With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: she works. Words like always, usually, often, sometimes and never go before the main verb: I usually walk to work.
explanation.uz: Muntazam qiladigan ishlar uchun present simple ishlatiladi. He, she va it bilan feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: she works. Always, usually, often, sometimes va never kabi soʻzlar asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi: I usually walk to work.
explanation.ru: Present simple используют для того, что вы делаете регулярно. С he, she, it к глаголу добавляют -s: she works. Слова always, usually, often, sometimes, never стоят перед основным глаголом: I usually walk to work.

examples: I always drink tea in the morning.
We sometimes eat lunch in the park.
She never watches TV at night.

items.title: Two friends talk about their week

lines.speaker: Malika
lines.text: You look tired, Rustam. Are you busy at work?

lines.speaker: Rustam
lines.text: Yes. I start at eight and I usually finish at seven.

lines.speaker: Malika
lines.text: That's a long day! How do you get to work?

lines.speaker: Rustam
lines.text: By metro. And you? Do you still work from home?

lines.speaker: Malika
lines.text: Only on Fridays. On other days I walk to the office.

lines.speaker: Rustam
lines.text: Lucky you. What do you do at the weekend?

lines.speaker: Malika
lines.text: I often go to the market on Saturday and see friends on Sunday.

items.prompt: Which sentence is about a regular habit?

explanation.en: 'Usually' shows a habit, and habits use the present simple. The other sentences are about now and about yesterday.

explanation.ru: 'Usually' показывает привычку, а привычки выражают через present simple. Другие предложения — о «сейчас» и о «вчера».

explanation.en: 'My brother' is he, so the present simple verb takes -s: works.
explanation.uz: 'My brother' — bu he, shuning uchun present simple feʼliga -s qoʻshiladi: works.
explanation.ru: 'My brother' — это he, поэтому глагол в present simple получает -s: works.

explanation.uz: Nonushta ertalab, tushlik kun oʻrtasida, kechki ovqat esa kechqurun boʻladi.
explanation.ru: Завтрак — утром, обед — в середине дня, ужин — вечером.

items.prompt: Put the words in the right order.

explanation.en: Words like 'often' go before the main verb: I often go to the gym.
explanation.uz: 'Often' kabi soʻzlar asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi: I often go to the gym.
explanation.ru: Слова вроде 'often' стоят перед основным глаголом: I often go to the gym.

items.title: A baker's day
items.text: Sherzod is a baker in Namangan. His day starts very early. He gets up at four o'clock, drinks a cup of tea and walks to the bakery. He makes bread from five until nine. At nine the shop opens, and his sister Gulnora sells the bread to customers. Sherzod has lunch at eleven, because he is always hungry by then. In the afternoon he cleans the kitchen and orders flour for the next day. He gets home at three and sleeps for an hour. In the evening he plays with his children and goes to bed at nine. On Sundays the bakery is closed, so he sleeps late.

questions.prompt: What time does Sherzod get up?

explanation.en: The text says he gets up at four o'clock.
explanation.uz: Matnda u soat toʻrtda turishi aytilgan.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано, что он встаёт в четыре часа.

questions.prompt: Who sells the bread?

explanation.en: His sister Gulnora sells the bread to customers.
explanation.uz: Singlisi Gulnora nonni xaridorlarga sotadi.
explanation.ru: Хлеб покупателям продаёт его сестра Гульнора.

questions.prompt: Why does Sherzod sleep late on Sundays?

explanation.en: The last sentence says the bakery is closed on Sundays.
explanation.uz: Oxirgi gapda yakshanba kunlari novvoyxona yopiq ekani aytilgan.
explanation.ru: В последнем предложении сказано, что по воскресеньям пекарня закрыта.

items.title: When are you free?
items.transcript:
Laylo: Hi Timur. Can we meet this week to practise English?
Timur: Sure. I'm busy on Monday and Tuesday. I work late on those days.
Laylo: What about Wednesday evening?
Timur: On Wednesday I go to the gym at six. But I'm free after half past seven.
Laylo: Great. Let's meet at eight at the café near the metro.
Timur: Perfect. See you on Wednesday at eight.

questions.prompt: Why is Timur busy on Monday and Tuesday?

explanation.en: Timur says he works late on Monday and Tuesday.
explanation.uz: Timur dushanba va seshanba kunlari kech ishlashini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Тимур говорит, что в понедельник и вторник работает допоздна.

questions.prompt: What does Timur do on Wednesday at six?

explanation.en: He says he goes to the gym at six on Wednesday.
explanation.uz: U chorshanba kuni soat oltida sport zaliga borishini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Он говорит, что в среду в шесть идёт в спортзал.

questions.prompt: Where will they meet?
options: At a café near the metro
questions.answer: At a café near the metro

explanation.en: Laylo suggests the café near the metro, and Timur agrees.
explanation.uz: Laylo metro yonidagi kafeni taklif qiladi, Timur rozi boʻladi.
explanation.ru: Лайло предлагает кафе у метро, и Тимур соглашается.

items.example: Good morning. Can I help you?

note.en: Shop assistants often say this first.

items.example: I'm looking for a warm jacket.

note.en: 'I'd like' is a polite way to say 'I want'.

items.example: Can I pay by card, or only in cash?

items.title: How much and how many

explanation.en: Use 'How much is ...?' for one thing and 'How much are ...?' for more than one. Use 'How many ...?' with things you can count: How many bags do you need?
explanation.uz: Bitta narsa uchun 'How much is ...?', bir nechta narsa uchun 'How much are ...?' ishlatiladi. Sanaladigan narsalar bilan 'How many ...?' ishlatiladi: How many bags do you need?
explanation.ru: Для одной вещи — 'How much is ...?', для нескольких — 'How much are ...?'. С исчисляемыми предметами — 'How many ...?': How many bags do you need?

examples: How many apples would you like?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Hello. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Nilufar
lines.text: Yes, please. I'm looking for a winter coat.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: The coats are over here. What size are you?

lines.speaker: Nilufar

items.title: City Post Office: opening times and services
items.text:
City Post Office, Navoi Street.
Opening times: Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00. Saturday, 9:00 to 14:00. Closed on Sunday.
Sending parcels: bring your parcel open, so we can check it. Boxes are for sale at the front desk.
Paying bills: you can pay electricity and water bills at window 3. Please bring your bill.
Collecting a parcel: bring your passport and the text message with your parcel number.
We accept cash and bank cards. Free Wi-Fi is available in the waiting area.

questions.prompt: When does the post office close on Saturday?

explanation.en: On Saturday it is open from 9:00 to 14:00.

explanation.ru: В субботу почта работает с 9:00 до 14:00.

explanation.ru: В объявлении сказано, что счета за свет и воду оплачивают в окне 3.

explanation.ru: Чтобы получить посылку, нужны паспорт и SMS с номером посылки.

items.title: Buying fruit
items.transcript:
Seller: Good afternoon! The grapes are very sweet today.
Zarina: How much are they?
Seller: Twenty-five thousand sum a kilo.
Zarina: I'd like one kilo of grapes, please. And how much are the pears?

prompt.en: You are in a shop. Ask for something you need, ask about the price and the size or colour, and ask how you can pay.

activities.title: Key phrases: talking about the past

instructions.en: Read the phrases and the example dialogue. Say each phrase aloud.
instructions.uz: Iboralar va namunaviy suhbatni oʻqing. Har bir iborani ovoz chiqarib ayting.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте фразы и пример диалога. Произнесите каждую фразу вслух.

items.example: Last weekend I visited my cousins in Khiva.
How was your trip? It was amazing!
What did you do on holiday? We went to the mountains.
I started this job two years ago.

note.en: Put 'ago' after the time: two days ago, a month ago.
note.uz: 'Ago' vaqtdan keyin keladi: two days ago, a month ago.
note.ru: 'Ago' ставится после периода: two days ago, a month ago.

items.example: The weather was hot, but the food was great.
Have you ever been to Samarkand? Yes, I went there last year.

note.en: Use this question about any time in your life. Answer with the past simple when you say when.
note.uz: Bu savol hayotingizdagi istalgan vaqt haqida. Qachonligini aytganda past simple bilan javob bering.
note.ru: Этот вопрос — о любом моменте жизни. Когда называете время, отвечайте в past simple.

items.title: The past simple

explanation.en: Use the past simple for finished actions. Most verbs add -ed: work, worked. Some common verbs are irregular: go, went; have, had; see, saw. In questions and negatives use 'did' and the base verb: Did you go? I didn't go.
explanation.uz: Tugallangan ishlar uchun past simple ishlatiladi. Koʻpchilik feʼllarga -ed qoʻshiladi: work, worked. Baʼzi koʻp ishlatiladigan feʼllar notoʻgʻri: go, went; have, had; see, saw. Savol va inkorda 'did' va feʼlning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi: Did you go? I didn't go.
explanation.ru: Past simple используют для завершённых действий. Большинство глаголов получают -ed: work, worked. Некоторые частые глаголы неправильные: go, went; have, had; see, saw. В вопросах и отрицаниях — 'did' и начальная форма: Did you go? I didn't go.

examples: She went to Bukhara last month.
Did you have a good time?
I didn't see him at the party.

instructions.en: Choose or complete the answers. You will see an explanation after each one.
instructions.uz: Javoblarni tanlang yoki toʻldiring. Har biridan keyin izoh koʻrasiz.
instructions.ru: Выберите или дополните ответы. После каждого вы увидите объяснение.

options: I goed to the cinema yesterday.
I went to the cinema yesterday.
I go to the cinema yesterday.
items.answer: I went to the cinema yesterday.

explanation.en: 'Go' is irregular. Its past simple is 'went'.
explanation.uz: 'Go' notoʻgʻri feʼl. Uning past simple shakli 'went'.
explanation.ru: 'Go' — неправильный глагол. Его форма в past simple — 'went'.

items.sentence: ___ you enjoy the concert last night?

explanation.en: This question is about last night, so it uses 'did' and the base verb 'enjoy'.
explanation.uz: Savol kecha kechqurun haqida, shuning uchun 'did' va asosiy shakl 'enjoy' ishlatiladi.
explanation.ru: Вопрос о прошлом вечере, поэтому нужны 'did' и начальная форма 'enjoy'.

items.prompt: Match each verb with its past simple form.

explanation.en: These are common irregular verbs. Learn their past forms as pairs.
explanation.uz: Bular koʻp ishlatiladigan notoʻgʻri feʼllar. Oʻtgan zamon shakllarini juftlik sifatida yodlang.
explanation.ru: Это частые неправильные глаголы. Запоминайте их прошедшие формы парами.

items.prompt: Put the words in the right order.

explanation.en: 'Ago' comes after the time: two years ago. The time phrase goes at the end.
explanation.uz: 'Ago' vaqtdan keyin keladi: two years ago. Vaqt iborasi gap oxirida turadi.
explanation.ru: 'Ago' идёт после периода: two years ago. Выражение времени стоит в конце.

instructions.en: Read the short text, then answer the questions.
instructions.uz: Qisqa matnni oʻqing, soʻng savollarga javob bering.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте короткий текст, затем ответьте на вопросы.

items.title: My first trip to Samarkand
items.text: Last spring my friend Madina and I took the fast train from Tashkent to Samarkand. The journey took only two hours. We arrived in the morning and went straight to the Registan. It was even more beautiful than in photos. In the afternoon we visited a paper workshop, where a master showed us how to make paper from mulberry trees. Madina bought a small notebook as a present for her mother. In the evening we ate plov at a small café and talked to a family from Italy. We stayed for two nights. It was a short trip, but I want to go back and see more.

questions.prompt: How did they travel to Samarkand?

explanation.en: The first sentence says they took the fast train.
explanation.uz: Birinchi gapda ular tezyurar poyezdda borgani aytilgan.
explanation.ru: В первом предложении сказано, что они поехали на скоростном поезде.

questions.prompt: What did Madina buy?

explanation.en: Madina bought a small notebook for her mother.
explanation.uz: Madina onasiga kichik daftar sotib oldi.
explanation.ru: Мадина купила маме маленький блокнот.

questions.prompt: How long did they stay?

explanation.en: The text says 'We stayed for two nights.'
explanation.uz: Matnda 'We stayed for two nights' deyilgan.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано: 'We stayed for two nights.'

items.title: A busy weekend
items.transcript:
Kamron: Hi Shahlo. How was your weekend?
Shahlo: Busy! On Saturday I helped my aunt move to a new flat.
Kamron: That sounds tiring. Did you do anything fun?
Shahlo: Yes, on Sunday we went to a football match. Our team won two-one.
Kamron: Great! I stayed at home and finished a book.
Shahlo: Which book?
Kamron: A detective story. I started it last month and I finally finished it on Sunday night.

questions.prompt: What did Shahlo do on Saturday?

explanation.en: She says she helped her aunt move to a new flat on Saturday.
explanation.uz: U shanba kuni xolasiga yangi kvartiraga koʻchishda yordam berganini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Она говорит, что в субботу помогала тёте переехать в новую квартиру.

questions.prompt: What was the score of the match?

explanation.en: Shahlo says their team won two-one.
explanation.uz: Shahlo jamoasi ikki-bir hisobida yutganini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Шахло говорит, что их команда выиграла со счётом два-один.

questions.prompt: When did Kamron start the book?

explanation.en: Kamron says he started it last month.
explanation.uz: Kamron kitobni oʻtgan oy boshlaganini aytadi.
explanation.ru: Камрон говорит, что начал книгу в прошлом месяце.

instructions.en: Prepare for one minute, then speak for about 30 seconds. Afterwards, compare with the model answer and tick the checklist.

prompt.en: A friend asks about a trip or a day out you enjoyed. Say where you went, when, what you did, and how it was.
prompt.uz: Doʻstingiz sizga yoqqan sayohat yoki dam olish kuni haqida soʻrayapti. Qayerga, qachon borganingizni, nima qilganingizni va qanday oʻtganini ayting.
prompt.ru: Друг спрашивает о поездке или выходном дне, который вам понравился. Расскажите, куда и когда вы ездили, что делали и как всё прошло.

preparationHints: Use the past simple: went, saw, ate.
Finish with how it was: 'It was ...'.
items.modelAnswer: Last summer I went to Lake Charvak with my family. We stayed in a small guest house for three days. We swam every morning and ate fresh fish in the evening. One day we walked up a hill and saw the whole lake. It was very relaxing, and I want to go again next year.

selfCheck.en: I said where and when I went.
selfCheck.ru: Я сказал(а), куда и когда ездил(а).

selfCheck.en: I used at least three past simple verbs.
selfCheck.uz: Kamida uchta past simple feʼlini ishlatdim.
selfCheck.ru: Я использовал(а) хотя бы три глагола в past simple.
